verdict.rationale: Evidence covers dispute/chargeback risk absorption for general card Checkout (crossmint-supp-10), but this describes Crossmint handling bank disputes, not a developer-facing refund API for initiating/tracking refunds on agent-placed orders. No refund endpoint, refund object, or tracking mechanism is documented anywhere for Agent Cards, Agent Wallets, or Agent Checkouts. Missing for 10: any refund API/endpoint, refund status tracking, and agent-order-specific refund workflow documentation.
